title: Q-CFP-worker-logs-on: every Worker keeps its logs on
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** CF-POSTURE-1 daily probe, rule `worker-logs-on` failed on the live account
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cfposture --rule worker-logs-on
**Status:** closed

With logs off a failing Worker leaves no evidence, so no loop can find the cause. Measured 2026-11-20: ultrastable-site and tenant-ps-web had logs off although their configs turn them on.

Remedy: deploy the Worker through a path listed in upload_paths (each sends observability), or add observability to its config

Measured:
- tenant-ps-edge
- tenant-ps-mail
- ultrastable-did-it-work
- ultrastable-mail-in
- ultrastable-mail-relay
- ultrastable-uptime

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-26T16:58:32Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: ValueError: agents/autonomy-policy.json: the FIND text is not in the file (or matches more than one place); copy the lines exactly as the file sho. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
